$comment: The single definition of every version we track upstream. A Dockerfile ARG, a seam manifest, a peerDependency and a release manifest that each carried their own copy meant 'bump the pin' was four edits and one of them was always missed. Tests assert every derived copy equals the value here; the nightly compatibility matrix is one job that loops over these keys.

dsh.notes: Pinned official 0.1.5-rc.1 release. Session logs use format V3 and migrate from supported predecessors without deleting originals. Native assistant streaming is process-local, while final messages remain durable. Browser authentication is unchanged. EviMed adapts persona prefix/suffix and confines new host/file APIs at the control-plane boundary; package seams and composed defaults are verified against this exact pin.

memos.notes: MemTensor/MemOS 2.0 Stardust, self-hosted. Not the vendored usememos-derived service under 记忆模块/, which still serves the user-facing memory records; MemOS is the opt-in semantic index behind capsule recall (docker-compose.memos-engine.yml overlay) until the memory base actually moves.

ollama.notes: Private CPU embedding runtime for MemOS. The OCI index, linux/amd64 child and bge-m3 registry manifest are independently pinned; only the one-shot initializer has egress.

openlist.notes: Self-hosted drive aggregator; v4.2.6 (2026-09-01), including access-control and authentication fixes from the current stable release. EviMed uses the pinned list, get and link contracts, then reads bytes through OpenList's same-origin proxy without following a provider-controlled redirect. The service runs with an isolated data volume and tenant-prefixed paths.

mineru.notes: Document parsing for CJK layout, tables and formulas; PyPI 3.4.5. `pypdf` stays as the fast plain-text fallback.

openviking.notes: Context database evaluated as the recall index behind `memorySubstrate` (`OPEN_SCIENCE_MEMORY_INDEX_PROVIDER=openviking`), not as a record store: its `write` offers replace/append/create and no compare-and-swap, so the `expectedVersion` the research-memory service enforces has no equivalent and two concurrent edits of one record would silently lose one. The server is AGPL-3.0 and runs unmodified as its own service; the CLI, plugins and examples are Apache-2.0. The container tag carries a `v` prefix (`ghcr.io/volcengine/openviking:v0.4.19`) while the PyPI version does not; the unprefixed tag simply does not exist and a compose file that names it fails at pull. Releases land every few days and have moved data layouts before (0.3.x needed a staged migration through 0.4.5; 0.4.18 changed ACL fields from boolean to string), so the pin moves only through the matrix. `@openviking/dsh-memory-plugin` is listed for the local `evimed-web` profile only: like the MemOS plugins it spawns an MCP proxy that talks to the server directly, which the hosted runtime may not do.
